contents: # Full configuration reference (models, scan, audit loop, rate limits, caching):
model: 'claude-opus-5-5' # Model for both the Attacker and Reviewer roles. Bundle default: claude-opus-5-5.
# reviewer_model: 'claude-haiku-5-5' # Lighter model for the Reviewer role. Falls back to `model` when unset.
# profile: 'balanced' # One-knob preset: fast | balanced | thorough. Explicit keys always win.
#         max_cost_usd: 5.0 # Abort cleanly (exit 2) once the estimated cost reaches this cap.
#     # Proactive rate limiting — any single dimension enables it: https://github.com/vinceamstoutz/symfony-security-auditor/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#auditrate_limit--proactive-throttling
#     rate_limit: # Example: Anthropic Start tier quotas for Claude Opus 5.5 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)
#         input_tokens_per_minute: 2000000 # Cached input tokens don't count toward Anthropic's limit.
